Indonesian tech's beta to US tech (5.54% vs 1.05% local) means global AI capex cycles, not local macro, dictate sector returns—position for continued US-led volatility.
sectors.ai: Buy Indonesian tech exposure via US-listed AI/semis (PLTR, ARM, MRVL) and local names tracking global AI capex, but rotate into SLIS/ALAB for domestic digital-payment and data-center momentum. The +3.5% aggregate with US outperformance signals sustained risk-on; add on pullbacks, avoid chasing +30% single-day spikes. Prioritize liquidity and earnings visibility over headline gains.

sectors.ai: Buy the Indonesian solar EPC and EV-bus names (TOBA, VKTR) into strength; US solar equipment (SEDG, ENPH, FSLR) is a tactical long on rate-cut repricing but trim into rallies. Prioritize AMRT and TRI for resilient earnings, but take profits on speculative spikes like AGAR and LUCY. Watch for pullbacks in ADES to add, as consumer staples remain a defensive core amid IDX volatility.
